transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because I’ve been having some thoughts that scared me. Not that I want to hurt myself, but more like… if I didn’t wake up tomorrow, maybe that would be easier. That’s what finally made me make the appointment.
How long have you been having these thoughts?

It’s been going on long enough that it started to worry me, but the thought that really scared me was that kind of “if I didn’t wake up tomorrow, that might be easier” feeling. I don’t want to hurt myself, but having that thought at all made me feel like I needed to come in.
How long have you been experiencing these kinds of thoughts about not waking up?

I don’t know the exact start date, but recently enough that it scared me into coming in. It’s those thoughts like, if I didn’t wake up tomorrow, maybe that would be easier. I don’t want to hurt myself, but just having that thought has been upsetting.
Have you been feeling sad or depressed most of the time lately?
Yes. Most mornings lately I wake up with this heavy, gray feeling, like everything already feels dull before I even get dressed for work. It’s not constant every second, but it’s been there a lot.
Have you been enjoying activities that you normally like to do?

Not really. I still try to do things I usually like, like setting out my paints or thinking I’ll go to pottery class, but when I’m there I just kind of stare at everything. I don’t feel that spark or interest I used to.
Do you feel pleasure when you're doing things that you used to enjoy?

No, not much. Like with painting, I’ll still set out my paints, or I’ll think about going to pottery class, but once I’m there I just kind of stare at the materials. I don’t feel that spark I used to get from it.
Have you noticed any significant change in your weight recently?
I haven’t really noticed a significant change. My clothes seem to fit about the same, and I haven’t been tracking my weight closely.
Have you been having trouble sleeping lately?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t been paying close attention to it, but nothing really stands out to me as a big change with my sleep.
Have you been feeling guilty about things lately?

Yes… I have. It’s usually about little things at work. I’ll keep thinking about a display sign being crooked, or if a trainee looked confused, and then I start telling myself I’m a useless supervisor. It feels out of proportion, but I still get stuck on it.
Have you been feeling restless or sluggish lately?

Yes, a bit. Some days I notice I’m pacing around the living room, or picking at my cuticles without really thinking about it. Other days I feel kind of slowed down, like even walking from the break room to the sales floor feels oddly slow.
Have you been feeling anxious lately?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed feeling especially anxious lately. If I do, it hasn’t stood out to me.
Have you noticed yourself moving more slowly than usual or feeling like it's an effort to do physical things?

Yes. Some days I do feel slowed down, like just walking from the break room to the sales floor takes more effort than it should. Other days it’s the opposite—I’ll catch myself pacing around the living room or picking at my cuticles without really meaning to.
Have you been having these thoughts about not waking up or death frequently?

Yes. Not constantly, but often enough that it scared me. I’ll have thoughts like, if I just didn’t wake up tomorrow, maybe that would be easier. I don’t want to hurt myself, but having those thoughts is what pushed me to make this appointment.
How many weeks or months have you been feeling this heavy, gray feeling most mornings?

About six months, I think. It’s been that low, flat feeling most mornings for long enough that even things that used to help, like my art class or morning walks, just don’t really feel restorative anymore.
Have you experienced any unusual perceptions, like hearing voices or seeing things that others can't, lately?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t heard voices or seen things that other people don’t see. Nothing like that lately.
Have you ever thought about how you would end your life if you decided to act on those thoughts about not waking up?
No, I haven’t made a plan like that. It’s more been the thought that if I just didn’t wake up tomorrow, it might feel easier. That scared me enough to come in, but I don’t want to hurt myself.
Have you noticed yourself feeling restless or sluggish more often than feeling normal?

Yes, I think so. Some days I’m restless and I’ll pace around the living room or pick at my cuticles without really meaning to. Other days I feel the opposite—like even walking from the break room to the sales floor takes more effort and I’m moving strangely slow.
Have you ever felt like your thoughts are not your own or that someone or something is controlling your mind?
No, I haven’t felt like that. My thoughts feel like they’re mine, even when they’re upsetting or hard to quiet down. I don’t feel like anyone is controlling my mind.
Have you experienced any unusual thoughts or beliefs that might seem strange to others lately?

Well… not strange like someone was controlling me or anything. But during that energized stretch, I really did think I could fix the whole store’s image by myself. I remember feeling sure my ideas were brilliant, and that the district manager just couldn’t see it. Looking back, that was probably bigger than was realistic.
Do you find that you're unable to experience pleasure from activities that you used to enjoy?

Yes. I still try to do the things I used to like, like setting out my paints or going to pottery class, but when I’m there I just kind of stare at the materials. I don’t feel that spark or enjoyment I used to get from it.
